Quick Beef and Bean Chili

Yield: 4 servings

Ingredients
- 1 pound ground beef
- 1 tablespoon chili powder
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1 teaspoon smoked paprika
- ½ teaspoon garlic powder
- 1 can (15 ounces) black beans
- 1 can (14 ounces) diced tomatoes
- 1 cup beef broth

Preparation
1. Brown the beef in a large pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
2. Add the spices and stir for 1 minute.
3. Stir in the beans, tomatoes and broth.
4. Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
